How many are there?''"
"''More than enough for the two of you. Nothing can save you.|Kanan Jarrus and the Eighth Brother|}} The '''Eighth Brother''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Terrelian Jango Jumper]] [[Gender|male]] [[Brother (Inquisitorius)|member]] of the [[Inquisitorius]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], the Eighth Brother frequently participated in the hunt for the growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]], specifically the rebel group known as the [[Spectres]]. During the [[Mission to Malachor|mission]] on the [[planet]] [[Malachor]] to capture the former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Maul]], he met his demise when he tried to escape using his lightsaber after Maul and [[Kanan Jarrus]] damaged it during their fight. ==Biography== ===Fallen Jedi=== {{Quote|Form up. Now. Your masters are here.''"
"''Masters? We have only one master. The Emperor.''"
"''Times have changed Eighth Brother.|The Grand Inquisitor and Eighth Brother|}} [[File:Inquisitorius-2017DarthVader6.png|thumb|left|250px|The Eighth Brother became a part of the Inquisitorius.]] The individual who became known as the Eighth Brother originally occupied a position within the [[Jedi Order]]. At some point after the [[Galactic Republic]] was reorganized into the [[Galactic Empire]], he was inducted into an Imperial agency of [[The Force|Force-sensitive]] [[assassin]]s called the [[Inquisitorius]], which was tasked with hunting down and eliminating any [[Jedi]] who survived [[Order 66]]. To accomplish this, he and his colleagues were trained by [[The Grand Inquisitor]] in the [[Inquisitorius Headquarters]] in [[The Works]], but soon fell under the command of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] when [[Darth Sidious]] first demonstrated the Inquisitorius to Vader, who continued their training in the ways of the [[dark side of the Force]]. The [[Grand Inquisitor]] informed Eighth Brother and his colleagues that they had two masters, Eighth Brother in response proclaimed that they only served Sidious, but was soon countered by the Grand Inquisitor who stated that times had changed. Vader continued the Eight Brother and his colleagues's training in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] of [[the Force]]. In doing so, he was taught the lesson of loss by unpleasant methods by Vader as all inquisitors in the Works were. Following a sparing session involving Fifth Brother, Seventh Sister, Ninth Sister and [[Thirteenth Sister]] in which Darth Vader tested Akaris strength, the Eighth Brother showed up alongside the [[Fourth Sister]], [[Sixth Brother]] and [[Tenth Brother]] to observe Vader best Akaris. Later the Eighth Brother was in the fighting pit in the Inquisitorius Headquarters when the Thirteenth Sister entered to train. The two then sparred against each other, with the Thirteenth Sister exacerbating afterward his homicidal nature, describing the Eighth Brother as someone looking for any potential excuse to kill.''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]'' In [[14 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Darth Vader (2017) 19|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 19]] to [[14 BBY]]. the Eighth Brother celebrated with all the other Inquisitors after Darth Vader, [[Fifth Brother]],[[Darth Vader (2017) 19|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 19]] Thirteenth Sister, and [[Tualon Yaluna]] successfully killed [[Eeth Koth]]. ===Age of the Empire=== ====Hunting Maul==== Following the Grand Inquisitor's [[Action at Mustafar|death]] at the hands of the Jedi [[Kanan Jarrus]] and his [[padawan]], [[Ezra Bridger]], the Brother and the other Inquisitors saw "new opportunities" to take his place by hunting down the two Jedi and their [[Spectres|crew]] on their [[VCX-100 light freighter|VCX-100]], called the ''[[Ghost]]''. However, while the Fifth Brother and [[Seventh Sister]]{{Rebels|Always Two There Are}} were given the chance to do so when [[Darth]] Vader dispatched them on the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor's]] orders,''[[The Siege of Lothal]]'' the Eighth Brother was given the task of hunting down [[Maul]], the former [[Sith]] [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], whom he knew only as "the Shadow." ====Trouble on Malachor==== [[File:Jedi_vs_Eight_Brother.png|thumb|250px|The Eighth Brother, when dueling Ahsoka Tano, Ezra Bridger and Kanan Jarrus.]] After eventually [[Mission to Malachor|tracking]] Maul to the [[Malachor Sith Temple|Sith temple]] on [[Malachor]] in [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' the Brother unexpectedly found Jarrus, Bridger, and [[Ahsoka Tano]]. After stalking them for a short [[time]], the Eighth Brother attacked the three and was surprised to see that they all had lightsabers, making him think he was facing three Jedi, but in smaller numbers, he decided to retreat. After the trio was split up, Tano and Jarrus tracked down and captured the Eighth Brother, who was unable to escape due to [[C1-10P|Chopper]] commandeering his [[TIE/ad v1]]. Captured, the Eighth Brother was interrogated by Tano and Jarrus, who asked how many Inquisitors there are and what he was doing in Malachor. However, the Eighth Brother gave only vague answers, not revealing the exact number of Inquisitors and saying that he was in Malachor hunting a shadow. When Tano and Jarrus were not looking, the Eighth Brother managed to send a covert signal, which was answered by the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister, with all three attacking Tano and Jarrus. However, the tables were turned on them when Bridger arrived with Maul in tow, the pair of them joining Tano and Jarrus and driving the Inquisitors off. [[File:The_light_and_the_dark.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Eighth Brother clashes with Ahsoka Tano while his two fellow Inquisitors clash with Maul and Kanan Jarrus.]] Fearing that Maul had claimed a [[Sith holocron (Malachor)|Sith holocron]] sought by Darth Vader, the Eighth Brother impulsively set out to hunt down the enemy and reclaim it. He attacked Jarrus and Bridger, knocking out the [[Jedi Knight]] before turning his attention to the apprentice, only to be driven off by Tano and Maul. Teaming up with the Fifth Brother, he then went after Tano and Jarrus while the Seventh Sister went after Bridger and Maul, only for Maul to arrive and damage his lightsaber with a strike. Maul then [[Death|killed]] the Fifth Brother whilst Jarrus hit the Eighth Brother's lightsaber with his own, further damaging it. Over-matched and outnumbered, the Eighth Brother attempted to flee using his [[lightsaber]]'s [[Double-bladed spinning lightsaber|spinning blades]] to fly away. He leapt from the [[Sith temple|temple]], only for his weapon to break apart in midair, causing him to fall to his death. ==Personality and traits== Like the other Inquisitors, the Eighth Brother was fiercely dedicated to the service of the Empire and Darth Vader. He was aggressive to the point that he often charged into action while his fellows hung back to allow him to weaken the enemy. He was also ruthless and cruel, demonstrating a willingness to drag out the terror of an enemy before killing them. However, his impulsive streak proved to be his undoing, as he chose to rely on his damaged lightsaber to escape when faced with battling three skilled enemies at once. According to the Thirteenth Sister, the Eighth Brother was someone looking for an excuse to kill. ==Powers and abilities== [[File:New Inq.png|thumb|right|The Eighth Brother, ready for combat]] The Eight Brother was [[Force-sensitive]], able to use the Force to summon his lightsaber from afar. He was skilled in the art of [[lightsaber combat]], able to fight [[Ahsoka Tano]]; with the help of the Seventh Sister, briefly fight Maul; before getting Force pushed off the temple, and [[Kanan Jarrus]] on even footing; before getting his lightsaber damaged. He is also skilled in deflecting blaster bolts from his own [[Eighth Brother's TIE fighter|TIE/ad v1]] and calling [[Eighth Brother's lightsaber|his lightsaber]] back to his hand after throwing it. His skills also includes being a successful tracker, evidenced by when he was sent to find Maul on Malachor. His fighting style was somewhat similar to the Seventh Sister's, given his slim and acrobatic build. However, he appeared to have been no more skilled than his fellow Inquisitors in battle, as illustrated by his losses on Malachor, but he needless manage to survive longer than the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister. ==Equipment== [[File:Eighth_Brother_lightsaber.png|thumb|left|110px|The Eighth Brother's lightsaber]] Like most Inquisitors, the Eighth Brother wielded a [[double-bladed spinning lightsaber]]. He also possessed a TIE/ad v1, the same [[TIE series|TIE Fighter design]] as his fellows. The Eighth Brother typically employed both of his blades in battle, and also employed them in order to propel away from enemies when outmatched. Additionally, his lightsaber had the unique ability to convert into a buzz-saw-like weapon that employed the handle while the blades were deactivated. In doing so, this allowed the emitters to be visibly seen. Other equipment the Brother used were a multitude of [[S-Mine Detonator]]s he kept on his [[belt]]. Within easy reach, the Eighth Brother would throw these small explosives toward his enemies. He also wore a suit of [[Color|black]] and gray combat [[armor]] which bore the insignia of the Galactic Empire. On at least one of his [[gauntlet]]s, he could send out a [[distress signal]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|His outfit was inspired by medieval plate armor.|[[Kilian Plunkett]]|''[[The Art of Star Wars Rebels]]''}} The Eighth Brother first appeared in "[[Twilight of the Apprentice]]," where he was voiced by [[Robbie Daymond]]. The Inquisitor was designed to be lithe and angular, with armor that was inspired by plated medieval armor. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: Force Arena]]'' *''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''
